name: BNO
fix_description: In emergencyWithdraw(), update the global total staked amount (e.g. totalAllocPoint or totalStaked) when clearing the user stake. The current implementation only resets user-level state but not pool-level accounting, allowing reward calculation manipulation.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward exploit centered on an obvious logic flaw in emergencyWithdraw/unstakeNft accounting. The PoC is short, uses only a simple flash swap for capital, and repeatedly performs the same 4-call sequence without requiring deep protocol knowledge or complex cross-contract reasoning.
